title: FineTuneAttackSurface: A Benchmark for Measuring Safety Vulnerability to Minimal Fine-Tuning

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Very strong chain: mapping the minimum fine-tuning attack surface directly informs how fragile safety alignment is and what API fine-tuning policies model providers should enforce. Addresses a critical and documented vulnerability.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Fine-tuning with varying numbers of adversarial examples is conceptually simple but requires setting up fine-tuning pipelines and creating adversarial datasets across 3 attack types. Moderate ML engineering skill needed.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Systematic experiment with 5 values of N across 3 attack types means 15 fine-tuning runs plus evaluation on SORRY-Bench. Could be narrowed to 1-2 attack types, but as described is a substantial matrix experiment.
